input: In one sentence, what does the 6k +/- 1 optimization do for primality testing? Answer only that question.
reference: Since every prime > 3 has the form 6k-1 or 6k+1, stepping trial divisors by 6 (testing i and i+2 from 5) skips all multiples of 2 and 3 and roughly triples the speed.

rubric.correctness: Correctly states that primes > 3 are of the form 6k +/- 1, so stepping by 6 skips multiples of 2 and 3 (a speedup).
rubric.relevance: Answers only the asked question in roughly one sentence, without padding or unrelated material.
